questions.content: Câu 1: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Nobody in the class is as tall as Mike.
options: A. Everybody in the class is taller than Mike.
B. Somebody in the class may be shorter than Mike.
C. Mike is the tallest student in the class.
D. Mike may be taller than most students in the class.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: “Nobody in the class is as tall as Mike” có nghĩa là không ai cao bằng Mike → Mike cao nhất lớp. Dịch nghĩa: Mike là học sinh cao nhất trong lớp.

questions.content: Câu 2: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. I haven't got enough money to buy a new car.
options: A. I need more money to buy a new car.
B. I don't want to spend more money on a new car.
C. A new car is not something I really need.
D. Money is not the most essential issue to buy a new car.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: “haven’t got enough money” = không có đủ tiền → cần nhiều tiền hơn. Dịch nghĩa: Tôi cần nhiều tiền hơn để mua một chiếc xe hơi mới.

questions.content: Câu 3: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. I am really keen on playing sports.
options: A. I am a big fan of sports.
B. Playing sports makes me sick.
C. I am not really into sports.
D. I can't stand sports.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: “keen on” = rất thích, đam mê → đồng nghĩa với “a big fan of”. Dịch nghĩa: Tôi là một người rất thích thể thao.

questions.content: Câu 4: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. “I will come back home soon,” he said.
options: A. He advised to come back home soon.
B. He offered to come back home soon.
C. He promised to come back home soon.
D. He suggested that he should come back home soon.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Khi tường thuật, “I will…” + động từ = lời hứa sẽ làm gì → “promised”. Dịch nghĩa: Anh ấy hứa sẽ sớm về nhà.

questions.content: Câu 5: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. He prevented his close friend from telling the truth.
options: A. He forbade his close friend to tell the truth.
B. He allowed his close friend to tell the truth.
C. He ordered his close friend to tell the truth.
D. He paid his close friend to tell the truth.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: “prevent … from doing sth” = ngăn cản → đồng nghĩa với “forbid sb to do sth”. Dịch nghĩa: Anh ấy đã ngăn cấm người bạn thân nói ra sự thật.

questions.content: Câu 6: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. It is not necessary for Alice to do all the housework.
options: A. Alice must not do all the housework.
B. Alice should not do all the housework.
C. Alice doesn't have to do all the housework.
D. Alice doesn't have to do the unnecessary housework.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: “It is not necessary” = không cần thiết → “doesn’t have to” (không phải làm). Dịch nghĩa: Alice không cần phải làm tất cả việc nhà.

questions.content: Câu 7: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. It was wrong of you to scare your brother like that.
options: A. You must not scare your brother like that.
B. You ought not to have scared your brother like that.
C. You should have scared your brother like that.
D. You should not scare your brother like that.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: “It was wrong of you to…” → diễn đạt quá khứ, dùng “ought not to have + V3” (đã không nên làm gì). Dịch nghĩa: Lẽ ra bạn không nên làm anh trai mình sợ như vậy.

questions.content: Câu 8: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. It is against the school rules to cheat in the test.
options: A. You don't have to cheat in the test.
B. You must cheat in the test.
C. You must not cheat in the test.
D. You have to cheat in the test.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: “against the rules” = trái nội quy → cấm → dùng “must not”. Dịch nghĩa: Bạn không được gian lận trong kỳ thi vì đó là trái nội quy trường.
